input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: § 8.2 provides automatic renewals of only twelve months, with a Customer opt-out on just thirty days' written notice and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal (plus an extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is missed), matching the preferred position on renewal term, notice window and reminder mechanics. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent, requires ninety days' notice of any increase, and expressly excludes prepaid periods, satisfying the pricing-predictability requirement. § 8.1 sets a fixed three-year term with no multi-year auto-renewal. No redline needed.
